rationale: Residual load after hydro and storage is 75, 90, 85 MW for h1-h3. Coal is cheaper, so dispatch is biased to its max feasible level while keeping gas at its 20 MW minimum (both units online). Coal: 55/70/65 MW; gas: 20/20/20 MW. Total cost = 22*190 + 38*60 = 6460 USD. Emissions = 0.75*190 + 0.35*60 = 163.5 ton, below the 200 ton cap.
